fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Fear, trauma and the chance to wake up", "body": "Matt Landman opens with a line he has long used: if you can wake up to chemtrails, or now to the coronavirus, you can wake up to anything. Chance describes the trauma of the situation as a kindling that can go one of two ways, and argues that every new trauma reawakens old ones, possibly even ancestral memory. Matt likens the daily drip of new rules and headlines to a movie theater of suspended disbelief that holds people in fight, flight or freeze, Chance argues that some people become addicted to fear, and Matt urges listeners to reach out to their neighbors."}, {"title": "Chance's doubts about testing and case counts", "body": "Chance questions whether the coronavirus has ever been purified and isolated, and says the PCR test amplifies genetic material until a subjective cutoff decides who counts as positive. He walks through the World Health Organization's early suspect case criteria, argues that China's February 16 switch to stricter definitions, not quarantine, is what brought its numbers down, and cites David Crowe's paper and the Diamond Princess cruise ship as reasons to doubt how infectious it is. Matt reads a Los Angeles Times estimate of a 0.9 to 3.4 percent fatality rate aloud and argues that mass testing means the curve will not flatten."}, {"title": "Is the crisis cover for a bigger agenda?", "body": "Matt asks who benefits, pointing to the 5G and Beyond Act, which he says was signed just as California locked down, a wave of CEO departures he links to Bill Gates, and the Event 201 pandemic exercise held the previous fall. Chance adds the Federal Reserve changing its capital reserve rules, the EARN IT Act he says would end online encryption, and a sweeping gun bill, HR 5717. Matt points to New Zealand's stage four lockdown and China's social credit system, and Trump's order for General Motors to build ventilators, with bailouts likely to follow, is framed as a drift toward fascism."}, {"title": "Disinformation, QAnon and the truth movement", "body": "Matt, who lobbies his own mayor about 5G, calls the theory that 5G is the virus bait that makes activists sound ungrounded, borrowing a friend's image of a turd in the punch bowl. Chance compares the infighting to 9/11 truthers arguing over thermite and directed energy. He calls the QAnon message of trusting the plan a comfort culture that outsources truth, and Matt, describing co-opted activists he met in the chemtrail scene, says following a faceless source like Q or Anonymous is self-destructive. Matt also says fear-based posts go viral while much of what he posts stalls, proof to him that virality is no longer organic."}, {"title": "Real hope versus hopium", "body": "Matt believes humanity is on a timeline toward ascension that is being hijacked, and says you can either take authority as the truth or truth as the authority. Chance answers that love allows infinity to grow rather than controlling it, that evil can only invert, and passes on Gordon White's advice that the old world is not coming back, so create your own reality, pointing to the April 4 Jupiter and Pluto conjunction as a window to do it. Matt suggests planting gardens, reading ingredient labels and helping neighbors, and Chance closes by contrasting real hope with the hopium of waiting to be rescued."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Matt Landman is an activist and the creator of the documentary Frankenskies. In this super-show we sift through the scientific statistics and ask several important questions that throw the mainstream explanation of the COVID-19 crisis into serious doubt. We cover a lot of ground on this one with the hope of keeping you grounded during the storm. Topics include the unproven theory of the what the virus even is, the enormous flaws in PCR testing (Polymerase Chain Reaction), the facts that impact the death statistics, and the problematic treatment protocols, and that's just scratching the surface.
